Smoke test: HTML table extraction

```swift title="Swift"
import Xberg

let result = try await Xberg.extract("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"text/html\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/html/simple_table.html\"}", "{}")
for table in result.results()[0].tables() {
    print(table.rows())
}
```
